edits.value: Backend and data engineer with six years building production systems, APIs, and data pipelines and owning them end to end. At Northbeam Logistics, designed the system architecture that split a fulfillment monolith into Java and Spring Boot microservices behind Kafka on AWS, cutting cross-team release conflicts 60% across 40 backend services. At Anchor Data Systems, rebuilt a nightly PostgreSQL warehouse load with Python, SQL, and change data capture, cutting the load window from 6 hours to 45 minutes.

Designed the system architecture that split the fulfillment platform's order-processing monolith into Java and Spring Boot microservices behind Kafka topics, giving each of the 6 core services its own deploy pipeline and contract tests and cutting cross-team release conflicts 60% across 40 backend services.
Senior Backend Engineer · Fulfillment Platform · 40 microservices, 6 core services on AWS · Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Terraform
